title: Save from Shortcuts and the Action Button
acceptance: An App Intent saves a URL to the library, usable from Shortcuts, the Action Button and automations
It goes through the same inbox the share extension writes to — no second save path exists
Saving succeeds whether or not the app is running
The intent reports success or failure back to Shortcuts rather than failing silently
It appears in Shortcuts with a sensible name and parameter summary
notes: Owner says capture is awkward. The share sheet is currently the only path and it is the slow one. Critically: one inbox, one pipeline — a second save path is how archives get inconsistent.
